dedupe_keys.name: electricitylci us power lifecycle inventory modeller

description: ElectricityLCI is a Python package produced by the US National Energy Technology Laboratory and Environmental Protection Agency to build regional electricity life-cycle inventory models. It combines facility releases, generation, fuel supply and distribution processes into configurable models of generation or consumption mix. Users choose a US region and YAML model configuration and supply access to source agency data; outputs are openLCA-compatible JSON-LD inventory models. Geographic coverage is the United States, while source years vary by selected datasets. The repository publishes CC0-1.0 code, setup instructions and model configurations without a software fee. A limitation is that three upstream services require free API keys, and some NETL information may require a repository issue; we did not request accounts or data. Results inherit source inventory boundaries and are not an electricity-dispatch simulation. ElectricityLCI can quantify lifecycle impacts of grid expansion and electrification scenarios. The catalogue's model-pypsa addresses power-system operation, not lifecycle accounting. No dataset or package was downloaded.
